originality.rationale: Tang–Fan (2026) establishes finiteness by Wendt determinant and computes exact characteristic sets g≤10 and a prime-field g=11 case; its actual full arXiv HTML §§2–6, Appendix A do not give unrestricted extension-degree g=13 classification. OEIS A048954 and Numericana tabulate W13 and prime factors but not realizability. Fan’s coprime-index classification treats X^r(X^{q−1}+a), a different family; no direct dominating all-g theorem with explicit membership was identified. Exact g13 {3,53} is a new computed application contingent on prior lemmas; literature-priority risk remains for independent large-index tables.
